critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/products/{pid}/badges (server.py ~7448) correctly RBAC-gates to admin + inventory_manager, dedupes badges, caps at 8, and stamps badges_updated_at/by — clean implementation.

POST /api/orders/{order_id}/reorder (~1250) correctly clones items + customer fields, sets reorder_of=<original>, status='pending', and enforces creator-or-elevated-role check. Verified 403 for unrelated telecaller (tc2).
GET /api/leads dedupe (~880) applies for admin/SM/asst-SM/DM/asst-DM/finance — telecallers/agents keep full pipeline. Verified deduped count == 1 for SM seeing two same-phone leads.
agent_store.sm_create_agent persists both store_url and agent_portal_url; new agent's GET list returns both fields — verified.

ADMIN_FORCE_RESET block (server.py ~430) is inside seed_database, gates on env var, updates password_hash + force_reset_at, and creates the admin if missing. Code path verified statically; no env mutation performed.
server.py is still ~8598 lines (carry-over modularity debt from iteration 41/42 — exceeds 700-line guideline).
